description: Single filer age 66 with a pension and interest, no Social Security: MAGI under 75,000, full senior deduction.
worked:
Line numbers are those of the 2025 Form 1040, its instructions' worksheets and Schedule 1-A; the figures are the 2026 ones from the federal file.
Filing status: single.
Taxpayer: born 1960-07-07, age 66 at the end of 2026.
Form 1040: line 2b taxable interest 4,000; lines 4b + 5b taxable pensions and IRA distributions 60,000.
Form 1040 line 9 total income = 4,000 + 60,000 = 64,000; line 10 adjustments 0; line 11a/11b adjusted gross income = 64,000.
Line 12e standard deduction = 16,100 basic (single) + 1 x 2,050 additional (unmarried amount, one per box checked on line 12d for age 65 or older / blind) = 18,150.
Schedule 1-A: line 1 = line 11b 64,000; line 3 MAGI = 64,000 (no excluded income).
  Part V: line 31 = 64,000; line 32 = 75,000; line 33: 64,000 - 75,000 is zero or less, so line 35 = 6,000
  line 36a (born before January 2, 1962) = 6,000; line 37 = 6,000 -> line 38 -> Form 1040 line 13b
Line 14 = 18,150 + 6,000 = 24,150; line 15 taxable income = 64,000 - 24,150 = 39,850.
Form 1040 line 16 (regular tax): Tax Rate Schedule X (single) on 39,850: 10% x 12,400 = 1,240; 12% x (39,850 - 12,400) = 3,294; total 4,534
Form 8960: lines 8 and 12 net investment income = 4,000; line 13 MAGI = 64,000; line 14 threshold = 200,000; line 15 = 64,000 - 200,000, zero or less, so 0; line 17 net investment income tax = 0.
Form 8959: no wages or self-employment income; additional Medicare tax 0.
Total tax = 4,534 regular + 0 net investment income tax + 0 additional Medicare tax = 4,534.
